purpose: Determine, without opening any return or PnL outcome, whether the immutable historical node_fills_by_block source exposes enough explicit TWAP-parent identifiers and repeated slices to support a direct parent-order continuation experiment.
economic_distinction: This is not historical-wallet skill copying and does not use any prior wallet return. The future hypothesis, if this schema gate passes, is that an already-observed same-parent TWAP sequence can reveal remaining scheduled inventory demand before its full cross-venue price impact is incorporated.
allowed_operations: download only the exact frozen warmup file
verify byte size and LFS SHA-256 before parsing
read event structure and fill-object key names
read wallet, coin, side, crossed, time, oid and explicit TWAP identifier fields
count identifiers, fill counts, elapsed spans and inter-arrival intervals
calculate same-side purity within an explicit TWAP group
prohibited_operations: access, aggregate, serialize or compare px, sz, fee, closedPnl, startPosition or any price/value field
calculate returns, markouts, labels, wallet skill, signal PnL or account PnL
read development, validation, 2026 or official Bybit outcomes
select a trading threshold from outcomes
valid_explicit_identifier: Non-null, non-empty and not numeric zero after string normalization.
incidence_metrics: fills carrying explicit TWAP ID by coin
groups with at least 2, 3, 5 and 10 fills
groups lasting at least 30, 60, 120 and 300 seconds
median and percentile positive inter-arrival seconds
repeated OID groups as non-promoting fallback evidence
if_passed: Freeze a separate causal TWAP-continuation screen before reading any price. The screen must define detection after completed slices, local availability delay, parent inactivity/end state, Bybit execution proxy, global slot, cost gates and untouched partitions.
if_failed: Do not infer parent orders from wallet performance. Explicit-TWAP continuation is retired for this source unless a different immutable historical source exposes the identifier. Repeated OID evidence cannot independently promote the experiment.
